ablation: A parser-free binary must continue to decline every semantic stream.
capability: Parse and resolve one Arena format 3.1.0 stream without assuming dense or ordered identifiers.
competing_explanation: A dense append-only table may be sufficient for normal exporter output but violates current static Arena fixtures.
decision_rule: Retain only if exact sparse-name and out-of-order-level fixtures parse while missing references fail as malformed input.
falsifier: Duplicate or missing references are accepted, or sparse/out-of-order fixtures cannot be represented without inherited checker code.

obstruction.statement: The starting state has no Arena parser or semantic store.
